theory_reference: Anderson, J.P. (1972/1980) reference monitor concept (complete mediation, tamperproof, verifiable) as invoked by mission.md itself; Saltzer & Schroeder (1975) 'complete mediation' design principle - a reference monitor must mediate ALL accesses/assertions of the protected class, not a single syntactic encoding of one.
